subject: English
question_text: Rearrange the following sentences to make a coherent order.
stimulus: (a) He was called Shilpacharya meaning ‘great teacher of art’ in Bangladesh. (b) It intensified the non-cooperation movement against the Pakistan regime. (c) The exhibition was a symbol to protest and a milestone for cultural freedom. (d) Zainul Abedin is considered the pioneer of Bangladeshi art. (e) He organized the Nabanna (harvest) exhibition in 1969. (f) He was the founder Principal of the first art school in Dhaka. (g) In the exhibition, a 65-foot long scroll was used to portray the poverty in East Pakistan. (h) He was an artist of outstanding talent and earned international reputation.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 d h a f e g b c
